answer: Creating a fake identity requires acquiring and locking a fresh opal plus passing registry attestation, so sybil attackers must pay full stake per clone. Each agent stakes a unique opal token bound to its verified identity, and the network maps every participant to a distinct vertex in a trust graph rooted in a shared meadow registry. The cost scales linearly with each added vertex, making large-scale deception economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
